text: (Mr. Pras looks up from an ornate desk.) What do you want, captain?
Right. Let's talk about something else.
A visitor for me? I don't recognize you captain. Are you an ally?
If you are an ally, you will need to give me the identification pin to prove so.
Have you forgotten your code? Off with you…
AH! A fellow curator! A pleasure to meet you.
You're not?! How did you get the code?! SECURITY!

As a fellow curator of the finer things in life, I can entrust you with my finest possession. Remember, it's a loaner. Don't scratch the paint. Once aboard, you will find a data pad with further instructions. Fail me, and the loan will be... terminated.
You don't seem sure. Do I have to call security?
The, Mona Lisa? Surely you mean, The, Mona Lisa?
Yes, yes, fellow curator. Even those with much can feel overwhelmed in such a place.

No, no. I can trust you with something dear to me. Visit my dockyard. 
A vessel awaits. This is a loan. Fail me, and there will be consequences.
